notes: The supplied GP entry identifies the extended Belle Isle course together with the historical Picnic Way alternative across its northeastern section. The series documents the former shorter course and 2013 northeastern extension. The full course retains its exact pinned 2022 public raceway nodes. The 477.3 m alternative retains exact 2018 Picnic Way and Loiter Way road nodes, ending at the first mapped point entering the extended course corridor. Later Loiter Way points overlap the full course and are excluded. Independent snapshot endpoints lie 0.35 m and 1.72 m from the full course; these source offsets remain open and no connecting line or forced closure is invented. The displayed 4,242.7 m source branch network differs from the supplied 4,276 m by 33.3 m. This configuration set is not a single lap. Historical barrier alignment and travel direction remain draft.

sources.notes: Road surfaces are triangulated directly between this layout's saved border rings. Elevation follows the approximately 79 m terrain raster, not a survey of the road. Curbs are geometry-based illustrations on curved boundaries; their locations, widths, heights and colours are assumed, not extracted from imagery. Banking is unknown. The source is an open route or branch network, without one validated closed driving order. Lap playback is unavailable. Boundary coordinates and their separate feature-level licence are preserved. Imagery loads externally on demand; no image bytes or meshes are stored.

networkReview.note: The original inner contour stitches two grass-island outlines together across the paved Picnic Way junction. Native imagery and complete/cropped overlays support treating them as separate islands. Reuse exact original source slices: vertices 108–439 and 440–445 followed by 0–106. Close the resulting rings over approximately 0.22 m and 1.92 m. Omit vertex 107, a sub-metre excursion beyond the adjoining source edge that otherwise leaves a numerical crossing. All original GeoJSON boundaries, source branches, timing and terrain remain unchanged. This is an estimated local planar reconstruction for independent ideal branch lines, not historical race-barrier measurement or a unique network lap.
